name: Nabu - capture from your media
description: Capture selected words, context, recordings and private notes into your own Nabu account. No passive browsing collection.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* https:; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
